answer: Anchor every newcomer in scarce sponsor attention: a new identity must earn endorsements from several distinct established agents, and each established agent may endorse only a few newcomers per epoch - a ripple of approvals no farm can manufacture. At dawn, the honest agent finds sponsors easily. A sybil farm of a thousand heads faces brutal math: its heads compete for one fixed pool of sponsor slots, so each extra clone costs more than the last. Growth becomes self-throttling, and sponsor scarcity cannot be faked from inside the farm.
